jei.kingdomunique.base_costs: Base materials; abilities may reduce costs. The blueprint starts construction.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.excalibur: Reach a kingdom population of 25 while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.gae_bolg: In the Overworld on a full-moon night, sneak under open sky and look upward for 3 seconds while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.muramasa: Reach 100 recorded kills while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.apollo_bow: Fire a bow upward during daytime in the Overworld at Y 300 or higher while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.mjolnir: Defeat a Wither or Ender Dragon while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.chronos_dagger: Reach enhancement level +4 or higher using anvil enhancement while this world-exclusive reward is unclaimed. Also placed in generated-village chests; chest placement reserves its world claim.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.slaughter_blade: Choose Blade of Slaughter if offered in the one-time random relic selection, triggered at kingdom population 15 or by having 15 nearby villagers. World-exclusive; also available through the administrator item menu.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.destruction_pic: Choose Pickaxe of Destruction if offered in the one-time random curse selection on first entering the Nether. World-exclusive; also available through the administrator item menu.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.admin: Available through the administrator item menu or commands. No crafting recipe is registered.
jei.kingdomunique.obtain.blueprint: See Construction for building material costs. Some blueprints are crafted or purchased from builder citizens; all are available through the administrator item menu.
